rv.q: But in this cultural hodgepodge the disparate elements don't often cohere.
Honestly, the most offensive thing about this show is how rarely it made me laugh.
The mosaic remains a mosaic: colorful, earnest, intermittently delightful, but rarely fused into a singular, resonant picture.
Maybe Chang should go back to the drawing board with these jokes and come up with a more polished—and enlightened—show.
